verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any public-page tool for checking the status of a filing, application, or case. The Business Tax Account and Tax record (transcript) items appear only as bare titles, with no description of status lookup. The documented online account access sits behind ID.me identity proofing rather than on public pages.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages
